name: Pull to refresh
summary: A gesture where dragging a list down past its top reloads it, with an indicator that shows progress. Always offer another way to refresh.

anatomy.purpose: A spinner or arrow that appears as you pull.
About 80px of pull triggers a refresh.

variants.name: iOS style
variants.use: Spinner appears under the nav bar.

whenToUse: Feeds and lists that update from a server.
whenNotToUse: As the only way to refresh.

notes: A gesture is not accessible alone: add a refresh control.

code.html: Refreshing
